Ti can be partitioned into the dendritic α-Al phase during solidification (via a peritectic reaction path) and remain inside the α-Al matrix even after the solution treatment because of the extremely low diffusivity of Ti in the α-Al matrix.

mechanisms.name: suppression of T-phase precipitate coarsening by solute Ti

evidence.quote: These results indicate that solute Ti suppresses the growth or coarsening of the T-phase precipitates during isothermal aging at elevated temperatures.

mechanisms.name: solute Ti interaction with Zn and Cu suppressing their diffusion

evidence.quote: The solute Ti interacts with Zn or Cu atoms (exhibiting negative mixing enthalpy values with Ti [39]) in the α-Al matrix, thus resulting in suppressed diffusion of these elements
Local coarsening associated with the formation of a stable phase may be facilitated by enhanced diffusion due to applied stress.
